events.text:
I fixed the window guard that stalled the Day 0 test run, and Day 0 is running again, but Days 0 to 3 are not finished yet, so T-461 stays in doing.

**What was wrong:** the guard checked usage for the default login, while the test runs bill a different account. Both readings shared one cache file, so the harness waited for two days on the wrong account's figure.

**What changed:** each billed account now gets its own usage reading (commit 43b0f460). The daily API caps are unchanged. I added this round to the test log (commit 7090dc22).

| Item | State |
|---|---|
| 1. Check run.py with ps, kill if stuck | Done. The old run (PID 4833) had already exited, so nothing needed killing. |
| 2. Check the reading, fix and commit budget.py | Done (43b0f460). The default login read 1% and the test account 53%, now in separate caches. After the restart the guard waited at 60% for that account's own reset, which shows it now reads the account it bills. |
| 3. Restart Day 0 r5 from start-endy | Done. The new run is PID 27005, logging to `revops-os/tests/runs-d0-r5.log`. Cards 0.09 and 0.10 ran and both failed review (0.09 on world_class; 0.10 on correct, works and world_class). Card 0.11 ran. |
| 3. Rerun 0.04 start-stack and 0.06 start-cloudflare | Not done. I confirmed the improver fixes from commit 5c3fe359 are on disk and that no "check.md" mention is left in the day 0 task file. |
| 4. Day 0 at 24 of 24 and check-checks flags nothing | Not done. Card 0.12 had just started when the run paused, and 0.13 to 0.24 have not run. The failing cards so far are 0.04, 0.06, 0.09 and 0.10. |
| 5. Day 1 r2, then Day 2 and Day 3 | Not started. |
| 6. Test log per round | Done for this round (7090dc22). |
| 6. Push after each day | Not done, because Day 0 has not finished. |
| 6. Move to review for Adi and Bharath | Not done. T-461 is set to doing and F-d6031805 is acknowledged. |

The run is in a real wait of about 4 hours: the test account is at 60%, and both API keys are over their $10 cap, so there is no fallback. It resumes by itself. A later run needs to fix and rerun the four failing cards, then do Day 1 r2, Day 2 and Day 3.
